## Why

The Legistar index pass fetched only `$top=100` ordered by
`MatterLastModifiedUtc` — a recency window with no keyword filter and no
paging. The I4/I8 research corpus documents historic surveillance
matters (ALPR renewals, RTCC expansions, EM contracts) that fall outside
that window on busy councils; I8 §4.1 reviewed the widening as an
adapter change (NEW-2): a second index slice carrying a
`substringof`-filtered, paged query, PLUS the client-side precision pass
that drops the broad-substring noise — and the agenda vocabulary had to
grow the term classes the keyword set names before the filter could
keep them.

## What ships

- **The second index slice is target data** —
  `connectors/src/connectors/data/procurement_vocab.toml`
  `[platform_endpoints.legistar]` gains `keyword_index_query`
  (`$filter=({or_group})&$top=1000&$skip={skip}`),
  `keyword_index_page_size = 1000`, `keyword_index_max_pages = 25`, and
  `keyword_index_groups` — the §4.1 term set verbatim (38 terms) split
  into four OR-groups so every generated URL is ~430–550 chars (bound:
  ~1,500). `tenant_targets()` emits the unchanged recency target plus
  one `paged` keyword target per group (`<tenant>:kw{0..3}`), each
  carrying the filled query template, the group's terms, the page bounds,
  the tenant's corrected jurisdiction, and the unchanged doc caps as
  data — fetch never constructs a query.
- **Bounded paging through the shared fetcher** —
  `procurement.py` `_fetch_paged_index` loops `$skip` by `page_size`
  until a page returns fewer than `page_size` rows or the reviewed
  `max_pages` bound — recorded as `truncated` on the merged capture's
  `sig_paged` provenance (every page URL + row count), never a silent
  stop. A first-page non-200, error envelope, or non-JSON flows through
  unmerged (disappearance / `tenant_api_error` / drift); a mid-slice
  failure keeps the fetched pages and marks the slice truncated.
- **Client-side precision filter** — `_agenda_precise_items` keeps a
  keyword-slice item only when its title matches the versioned
  `agenda_content_vocab.toml` regexes (word-boundary reviewed patterns —
  case-insensitive, pinning the I4 Q5 collation inference). The recency
  slice is unfiltered; a matter seen by both passes is one claim through
  `content_digest`. `extract()` emits an `agenda_index_slice` outcome row
  per paged slice — pages, item counts, `dropped_count` — so a noisy
  group or truncated slice is first-class run record.
- **Per-tenant document window** — `discover_more()` groups index
  captures by `tenant_id` and dedupes items by item id before bounded
  selection: the reviewed `doc_per_tenant = 20` / `doc_run_cap = 350`
  window bounds the merged item set, never a per-capture window — the
  widened pass cannot double document fan-out.
- **Vocabulary bump** — `agenda_content_vocab.toml` → `2026.10.10`:
  additive `automated_traffic_enforcement`, `mobile_forensics`,
  `video_analytics`, `biometric`, `electronic_monitoring`,
  `school_surveillance` terms plus vendor rows (Axon, BriefCam, Genetec,
  Rekor, Fusus, Verra Mobility, Clearview AI — disambiguated forms only,
  the CROL false-positive class); `alpr` gains `license plate`/
  `licence plate`/`license plate camera`; `drone` gains `unmanned aero`;
  `gunshot_detection` gains the locator phrasings;
  `social_media_monitoring` gains the SMM vendor names on word
  boundaries. No prior row or pattern rewritten.
- **Discover dedupe** — `discover()` dedupes agenda targets on id + URL
  (was `tenant_id`) so a supplied recency row never suppresses the
  generated keyword slices.
- **Tenant verification** — `ousd` and `washoe_county_nv` confirmed as
  genuine InSite tenants (`platform = "legistar"`, `api_base` on
  `webapi.legistar.com/v1/`): the widened pass reaches them; nothing
  moves to ACQ-22 in this row.
- **Tests + fixtures** — `tests/connectors/test_agenda_keyword_pass.py`
  (15 tests) over committed fixtures: cabq recency + two-page keyword,
  columbus + newark single-page, false-positive items (pigeon-Flock,
  gunshot-victims, Saxon/workers-comp — the I4-C218 class), the
  corrected-label consumption, OUSD/Washoe disposition, the 3h
  `task_timeout` pin.

## Validation

- `make check` — green: ruff, format, mypy (339 files), **7479 passed /
  501 skipped**, `verify-gen` clean.
- `uv run pytest tests/connectors` — 1130 passed, 1 skipped
  (SIG_GCP_PROJECT-armed per P34.2's fail-closed leak check).
- `uv run pytest tests/connectors/test_agenda_keyword_pass.py` — 15/15.
- `sig-connectors validate` — exit 0: 587 registered, 236 permitted
  **unchanged** (no `ingestion_permitted` flips).

#### Test plan

- Paging: a full page fetches the next (`$skip` steps by `page_size`), a
  short page stops the loop, `max_pages` records a truncated slice,
  mid-slice failure keeps fetched pages, first-page error envelopes stay
  `tenant_api_error` rows.
- Precision: keyword-slice items survive only on a vocabulary match —
  pigeon-Flock / gunshot-victims / Saxon-workers-comp noise drops; ATE,
  EM, ALPR, RTCC, vendor terms keep; an ALL-CAPS title keeps matching
  (the I4 Q5 pin).
- Dedupe: a matter in recency + four keyword captures emits five rows
  that canonicalise to one claim tuple; a recency-only item lands once,
  vocabulary-free.
- Window: with `doc_per_tenant` pinned to 2, a four-item merged set
  resolves exactly 2 document fetches — the window is per tenant.
- Shadow/replay: `shadow_replay` → `changed_count == 0`; `replay` →
  canonical-identical set (+0 replay inserts nothing).
- Config: the recency query is byte-identical; term set verbatim; URL
  bound <1,500 chars; `task_timeout = "3h"`; the six P35.7 corrected
  labels ride every slice; OUSD/Washoe stay Legistar.
- Part VIII: no person/plate predicates, no forbidden tokens in the
  widened rows.
